news.label: DeepMind Genie 4
points: Generates AI worlds you can control
Creates ambient sound and dialogue too
details: You can steer the world as it's generated, using a keyboard or plain language, and change the weather, characters and camera.
It isn't publicly available yet, and long-term consistency and physical accuracy are still challenges.

news.label: OpenAI Pando
points: Median push time cut by about 80%
Ten weeks from design to rollout
details: It uses a distributed architecture built to handle huge numbers of branches and simultaneous pushes.
OpenAI says it cut median push latency by about 80 percent in its own environment, and that agents such as Codex handled implementation and testing.

lines.say: It's a Git platform built to hold up even when lots of AI agents develop at the same time.
lines.show: It's a Git platform built for many AI agents developing in parallel.

lines.say: They say the median wait time for a push dropped by about eighty percent.
lines.show: The median push wait time reportedly dropped by about 80 percent.

link.title: I Looked Into "Pando," OpenAI's Rebuilt Git Server | DevelopersIO
link.description: A walkthrough of the design of OpenAI's Git-compatible backend Pando, from push to fetch, with examples: trunk-based packfile reuse, ref versions for dependencies, causal consistency, regional caches,

news.label: FreeScan Launches in Japan
details: The maker claims up to two hours of operation on a single battery.
The accuracy is a rated figure under certain conditions set by the manufacturer, not a guarantee for every object.
Along with fast scanning, it has VPG, which helps limit accuracy loss on large objects.

lines.say: Now to Japan, where Shining three D has a new scanner.
lines.show: Now to Japan, where SHINING 3D has a new scanner.

lines.say: It's called the FreeScan Combo Plus Wireless, and it weighs just five hundred fifty grams.
lines.show: It's the FreeScan Combo+ Wireless, weighing just 550g.

lines.say: Being able to carry it around and scan with no cable is a real plus, isn't it?
lines.show: Carrying it around and scanning with no cable is a real plus.

news.label: RobotBrain for Disaster Response
points: Some features still in real-robot testing
details: You give instructions by chat or voice.

It works out where communication is possible and which routes to enter by, then presents action plans for walking, driving and drone units, and the village search shown publicly was a fictional simulation, though some testing is under way on four-wheeled and four-legged robots.
